title: Blue Notebook Review: Operation Impacts, New Tech & Traffic Safety 🚓💙
description:
In this week's Blue Notebook Review, Sergeant Verbeck and the team provide essential updates on community safety, operational highlights, and a look into the future of the SMPD.

Highlights include:
Operation Overview: Over 2,700 calls for service and 119 arrests this period, focusing on retail theft and beach safety. 

The New SMART Center: A behind-the-scenes (and slightly unauthorized!) sneak peek at our upcoming command hub. 🖥️🏢

Traffic Enforcement: Over 500 traffic stops, with a reminder to keep your "Eyes Up, Phone Down." 📵🚗


We also answer your top comments and give a special shoutout to Petramale Pizza! 🍕

Stay connected with us:
📸 Instagram: @santamonicapd
🐦 Twitter: @SantaMonicaPD
💻 Website: santamonicapd.org

Don’t forget to Like, Share, and Subscribe!
#SMPD #PublicSafety #CommunityPolicing #SantaMonica #TrafficSafety #BlueNotebookReview
